## Summary

<!-- What's wrong, and exactly where. Link to the specific line with a
     permalink pinned to a commit SHA, not a branch — branch links rot as
     line numbers move. On GitHub, press "y" on a file view to convert the
     URL to a permalink. -->

## Context

<!-- The supporting facts a reader needs to judge this.

     State what you actually checked and how — "searched the repo for
     readers of this field", "reproduced on a clean build", "found by
     reading the code, not run". If something is inferred rather than
     observed, say so here. Never present an inferred step as if it were
     executed. -->

## Options

<!-- Possible ways to resolve it. Lay out the alternatives rather than
     prescribing one, unless there's genuinely only one sensible fix.
     If you're willing to implement it, say so. -->
